```{r setup-Rmd, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, 
                      fig.align = "center",
                      # Make sure to create the folder
                      fig.path = "../figures/02_AssignASVs")
```


# Prepare Environment 
```{r setup}
set.seed(238428)

# set the number of threads 
n_threads = 8

# Load packages 
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, dada2, patchwork, 
               install = FALSE)
```

# Load in QC'd FastQ files 

```{r load-fastqs}
filtered_fastqs_path <- "data/01_QualityTrimming/filtered_fastqs"
filtered_fastqs_path

# Forward read vector 
filtered_forward_reads <- 
  list.files(filtered_fastqs_path, pattern = "R1_filtered.fastq.gz", 
           full.names = TRUE)

# View the files
head(filtered_forward_reads)
length(filtered_forward_reads)

# Reverse read vector 
filtered_reverse_reads <- 
  list.files(filtered_fastqs_path, pattern = "R2_filtered.fastq.gz",
             full.names = TRUE)

# How many reverse QC'd files? 
length(filtered_reverse_reads)

# Test 
stopifnot(length(filtered_forward_reads) == length(filtered_reverse_reads))

# Create vector of sample names 
sample_names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(filtered_forward_reads), "_"), `[`, 1) 
# Check the names 
sample_names
```

# Error Model 

## Learn errors 

```{r learn-errors}
# Forward 
error_forward_reads <- 
  learnErrors(filtered_forward_reads, multithread = n_threads)

# Reverse
error_reverse_reads <- 
  learnErrors(filtered_reverse_reads, multithread = n_threads)

# Plot the errors 
## Forward 
forward_error_plot <- 
  plotErrors(error_forward_reads, nominalQ = TRUE) + 
  labs(title = "Forward Reads: Error Model")

## Reverse
reverse_error_plot <- 
  plotErrors(error_reverse_reads, nominalQ = TRUE) + 
  labs(title = "Reverse Reads: Error Model")

# Plot them together 
forward_error_plot + reverse_error_plot
```

# Infer ASVs Separately on Forward and Reverse Reads 

```{r infer-ASVs}
# Forward ASV Inference 
dada_forward <- 
  dada(filtered_forward_reads, 
       err = error_forward_reads, 
       multithread = n_threads)

# Reverse ASV Inference
dada_reverse <- 
  dada(filtered_reverse_reads, 
       err = error_reverse_reads, 
       multithread = n_threads)

# Take a look at the data 
typeof(dada_forward)
dada_forward
str(dada_forward)
str(dada_forward$WaterControl_R1_filtered.fastq.gz)
```

# Merge Forward & Reverse ASVs 

```{r merge-ASVs}
merged_ASVs <- 
  mergePairs(dada_forward, filtered_forward_reads, 
             dada_reverse, filtered_reverse_reads, 
             verbose = TRUE)

# Evaluate the output 
typeof(merged_ASVs)
length(merged_ASVs)
head(merged_ASVs)

# Take a look at a sample 
merged_ASVs$WaterControl_R1_filtered.fastq.gz
```

# Create Raw ASV Count Table 

```{r raw-asv-table}
raw_ASV_table <- makeSequenceTable(merged_ASVs)

# What are the dimensions of that table 
dim(raw_ASV_table)
rownames(raw_ASV_table)
colnames(raw_ASV_table)
typeof(raw_ASV_table)
class(raw_ASV_table)
```
